## Live-leg queue (all legs queued — none has run) — due evaluation at the evaluation instant

A leg is **due** when its earliest instant has passed and its go is held (OM-19); a verbatim/operator go not yet given is `awaiting-go`, never due; a `pre-authorised:` go whose recorded expiry has passed (the 11A S5-3/GB-Q4 list expired at the signed GATE-G4) is awaiting-go too — the packet's recorded default "each re-asks in-ticket" applies. `conditional` = the earliest's named extra conditions are not machine-verifiable; `indeterminate` = no parseable earliest. Leg earliest/go cells are quoted verbatim inside code spans (their own markdown ticks render as `'`); a code-quoted cell is verbatim record text, never an assertion of its production words.
